title: Keep workstation outputs on external storage
changes: Moved the selected workstation output directory to a separate ext4 image on the external disk and preserved its checkout path through a systemd bind mount.
Documented independent free-space limits, mount dependencies, recovery and ejection for both external directories.
validation: Initial copy and reconciliation exited successfully; a metadata inventory reported no differences before cutover. The active bind, filesystem identity, read-write options and automatic mount dependencies were inspected.
The source was removed after cutover; the internal disk reported 24 GiB free. Systemd unit syntax and the udev rule passed configuration checks.
limitations: The comparison did not read every file byte; reboot and physical disconnect or reconnect were not tested.
